package.name: box_hardware_adapter
package.description: Bridges box_manager's dib_msgs service/topic contract to box_simulation's ros2_control (JointTrajectoryController) topics. Serves lid/clamp/power/ charge/cooling command services and publishes lid/clamp/charge/cooling status derived from /joint_states. See README.md for the unit-mapping and the stubbed (non-physical) charge/cooling behaviour.
